notes.title: Thanks for the Support!
notes.content:
Hey Folks!

We are really excited about the Maize launch and seeing the positive response from all of you! Thank you all for helping us with a successful launch weekend!

We have been listening to you all as we've been reviewing the forums, and we are working on an update so please stay tuned!

If you had some fun with Maize, please post a review and help spread the love! It'll make Vladdy ever so happy. Just look!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26072080/b6423559dc05796d5676b09d30e6057d1febdabf.jpg

Cheers,
- Maize Team
